dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary structures exhibit irregular 'O' and 'C' perimeters with high-intensity light boundaries transitioning abruptly to low-intensity internal cores; edges are jagged and non-uniform.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels are densely concentrated in the anterior region, appearing as solid, asymmetrical points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal rings form an asymmetrical quadrilateral, with the apex directed towards the anterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, interconnected network of high-contrast annular perimeters forming a complex topological mesh across the mid-dorsal region.
